{{Top|leg}}
'''Antigrav platforms''' were [[Antigrav/Legends|antigrav]] technology used by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]]. During [[Herd Meet/Legends|Herd Meets]], when numerous [[Ithorian Herdship]]s gathered together at a central location, they were connected by an intricate web of bridges and antigrav platforms to allow easy travel bettwen the vessels.<ref name="EGTPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>
